name: slices
description: What a bolt's slices give its card, its board item and its gate: each slice's cuts as ordered steps, its cuts, data, entry and cuts done, and what the pack's graph shows of its data and entry (docs/design/slice-method.md).

messages.cardSlices:
Run each slice's scaffold command first: it writes each cut's own code and test and keeps what exists. Then build its cuts in order, each one's failing test before its code. The reviewer reports a cut the diff leaves missing, or hollow: a stub, or a test that passes without its code.
{{slices}}
messages.boardSlice: Slice {{slice}}: cuts {{cuts}} ({{done}} of {{total}} done); data {{data}}; entry {{entry}}
messages.sliceDataEdge: slice {{slice}} reaches data node {{node}}, which its declaration does not name
messages.sliceEntryUnwired: runtime {{runtime}}, the entry of {{slices}} in domain {{domain}}, does not import {{layer}}
messages.sliceEntryOther: runtime {{runtime}} imports domain {{domain}}'s interface layer, though its slices name {{entries}} as their entry
messages.sliceIntegrateUnreached: slice {{slice}} declares {{name}}, which its code never imports
messages.sliceIntegrateUndeclared: slice {{slice}} imports {{to}}, which its declaration does not name

SLICE-DATA.fix: name each data node the slice's code reaches in its declaration's data part, or reach it through the domain's model (docs: Building a slice)

SLICE-INTEGRATE.fix: name each client, adapter, extension and event the slice's code reaches in its declaration's calls, emits or consumes, and drop one its code does not reach (docs: Building a slice)
